news.title: Are You Overpaying For Reddit Stock Versus Its Rivals?
news.summary: Investors pay more for each dollar of profit from Reddit (RDDT) than they do for Meta Platforms, Alphabet, or Match, the rivals in its peer group whose earnings can be compared. That valuation would be easy to accept if Reddit simply executed better across the board. The company does grow faster than all four of its peers, Pinterest included. Yet it keeps less of its revenue as operating profit than three of them. So what do you get for the extra price.
news.title_zh: 您是否為 Reddit 股票相對競爭對手支付過高價格？
news.summary_zh: 投資者為 Reddit (RDDT) 每美元利潤支付的價格，高於同業可比較的 Meta Platforms、Alphabet 或 Match。若 Reddit 只是全方位表現更好，該估值容易被接受。該公司確實比所有四家同業（含 Pinterest）成長更快。然而，其保留為營業利潤的營收比例卻低於其中三家。那麼，您為額外溢價得到了什麼。

news.title: How CoreWeave’s Debt Binge Brought a Moment of Reckoning
news.summary: In early 2023, Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman gathered with Jas Khaira, the company’s lead AI investor, and other top executives at the finance giant’s Park Avenue headquarters in Manhattan for a debate: Should they give billions of dollars to a little-known data center developer—CoreWeave—that they had turned down just a few months earlier? CoreWeave had gotten Blackstone to return to the table after landing a multiyear, multibillion-dollar contract to sell cloud computing services to Microsoft. It needed $2.3 billion to buy Nvidia GPUs and secure a data center to house them. In Blackstone’s discussion of the deal, several executives in the room had deep misgivings, according to a person who attended the meeting. CoreWeave was still something of a mystery, a six-year-old, privately held firm that had generated only $16 million in revenue in the previous year. Schwarzman himself was personally worried his investment team could be making a mistake, the person said.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave債務狂飆如何帶來清算時刻

news.summary: Airbnb (ABNB) stock trades at 38.3 times its earnings over the four quarters to fiscal Q2 2026. During the company's October 13 call, management raised its 2026 outlook to adjusted earnings per share of at least $20.50. Yet executives also warned that medical costs remain stubbornly high across health care. So which part of UnitedHealth's care business still has room to grow.
news.title_zh: UnitedHealth 下一波成長將從何而來？
news.summary_zh: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) 可能在其提供的照護中尋找下一個成長引擎。此觀點目前極具分量。在公司的 October 13 電話會議中，管理層將其 2026 展望上調至每股調整後盈餘至少 $20.50。然而高管也警告，醫療成本在整個醫療保健領域仍頑強居高不下。那麼 UnitedHealth 的照護業務哪一部分仍有成長空間。

news.title: UnitedHealth Fell 51.32%, Then Rose 40.64%. DIA’s Exposure Followed Both Moves by Design
news.summary: UnitedHealth's wild ride inside DIA was not an accident or a manager's call. The weighting rule baked into the Dow determined exactly how much of your money followed the stock up and down, and most investors have never read that single line in the prospectus.
news.title_zh: UnitedHealth 下跌 51.32%，隨後上漲 40.64%。DIA 的持倉依設計跟隨雙向波動
news.summary_zh: UnitedHealth 在 DIA 中的劇烈波動並非意外或經理人決定。道瓊指數內建的權重規則精確決定了您的資金有多少跟隨該股票上下波動，而大多數投資者從未閱讀招募說明書中的那一行條文。

news.title: What Happened With UnitedHealth Stock This Week?
news.summary: Shares of UnitedHealth Group (UNH) rose 4.5% over the two trading days through Wednesday, October 14, while the S&P 500 fell 1.1%. The company reported fiscal Q3 2026 results before the market opened on Tuesday. The stock slipped 0.2% that day before posting its gain on Wednesday. Management also raised its forecast for full-year 2026 earnings. So what did the report change for someone who owns the shares.
news.title_zh: 本週 UnitedHealth 股票發生了什麼事？
news.summary_zh: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) 股價在截至週三 October 14 的兩個交易日內上漲 4.5%，而標普 500 下跌 1.1%。公司於週二開盤前公布了財政 Q3 2026 業績。該股當天下滑 0.2%，隨後在週三錄得漲幅。管理層也上調了全年 2026 盈餘預測。那麼，這份報告對持有該股票的人意味著什麼變化。

news.summary: UnitedHealth Group topped Q3 2026 revenue and EPS estimates and raised its full-year outlook, but shares erased early gains as investors questioned future growth amid shrinking membership.

news.title: Is Broadcom Stock Cheap Enough Yet?
news.summary: Shares of Broadcom (AVGO) closed at $328.75 on October 16, 2026. That price sits 31.5% below the highest close of the past year, which the stock reached on June 2. Shareholders lost 5.7% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned 16.2%. Even after that fall, a buyer today is betting that Broadcom's surge in AI chip sales keeps going. So has the fall gone far enough, or is it still early.
news.title_zh: 博通股票現在夠便宜了嗎？
news.summary_zh: 博通 (AVGO) 股價收於 $328.75，日期為 October 16, 2026。該價格較過去一年最高收盤價低 31.5%，最高收盤價出現於 June 2。股東過去十二個月虧損 5.7%，而標普 500 報酬為 16.2%。即使經過這波下跌，今日買方仍押注博通 AI 晶片銷售的激增將持續。所以跌幅是否已經足夠，還是為時過早？

news.title: Broadcom Vs. Marvell: Custom Silicon is Going to Get White Hot

news.title: What Just Happened To Marvell Stock?
news.summary: Shares of Marvell Technology (MRVL) fell 17.2% over the five trading days from October 9 to October 16, 2026. The broader market saw far less movement during that window, with the S&P 500 losing 1.9%. The stock first slipped the day after its October 6 Investor Day, an event where management actually raised its revenue outlook for fiscal 2028. So how hard was the week for Marvell, and what does its price still appear to assume.
news.title_zh: Marvell 股票剛發生什麼事？
